# Coding Instructions

- When writing or modifying C, C++, Objective-C, or Objective-C++ code, put exactly one blank line after each compound statement body (`if`/`else`, `for`, `while`, and `do/while`) before the next statement or control block. Apply this even when clang-format does not insert it automatically.
- Keep generated or edited code consistent with the repository `.clang-format`; run clang-format on changed files and inspect the result, then preserve the blank-line rule above.
